title: DE/F1: manifest schema exists only as comments — no mdatron JSON Schema pair; artifact silently unvalidated
description: Evidence: templates/registry/installed-artifact-manifest.yaml carries its field types, enum members (class, lifetime, fail_mode, resolution), and constraints as YAML comments only; .mdatron/schemas/ holds four JSON Schemas (domain-prompt, phase-primer, review-entry, supplement) and none for installed-artifact-manifest; mdatron verify's default file_globs are **/*.md (mdatron-core/src/verify.rs:55), so a .yaml data artifact is not even walked. Result: a governed versioned-data artifact that no mechanical check validates — the silently-unvalidated class the contract's availability-is-not-activation discipline names, in data form. Fix rides the carrier decision (sibling finding): whatever carrier is ruled, the set ships as a PAIR — data artifact + .mdatron/schemas/<schema_class>.json — and the pair rule generalizes to all 18 sets of #598. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect (affects how every data-set deliverable ships).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: schema pair authored and validating — .mdatron/schemas/installed-artifact-manifest.json landed with the data artifact; mdatron verify validated the manifest against it at the landing commit. Evidence: commit fdbc3dc3 (mdatron verify clean at commit time), vsdd-cli #658 trail.
